title: Micme configuration
description: Machine-level Micme settings. Shell environment variables override saved values. Invalid numeric values fall back to the documented defaults at runtime.

MICME_SHORTCUT.description: Unified toggle shortcut. Use terminal syntax such as alt+m/ctrl+space/f8, or a printable character such as §.

MICME_PRINTABLE_SHORTCUTS.description: Legacy printable-character fallback. Prefer MICME_SHORTCUT with a printable character.

MICME_TRANSCRIPTION_MODE.description: Stream uses the local micme-live worker and speech detector. Clip does not require either component.

MICME_TRANSCRIBE_BACKEND.description: Clip auto selects a custom command, whisper.cpp, then Python Whisper. Stream requires auto or whisper.cpp.

MICME_TRANSCRIBE_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout in whole milliseconds for clip transcription and live readiness, PCM acknowledgments and finalization. Runtime range: 1000 through 3600000.

MICME_LANGUAGE.description: Transcription language when translation is off. Use auto for language detection.

MICME_TRANSLATE_TO_ENGLISH.description: Translate from control. off disables translation; any language code means translate speech in that source language to English.

MICME_AUTO_DOWNLOAD_MODEL.description: Automatically download missing standard Whisper ASR weights and the standard live VAD weight when needed. Defaults on.

MICME_DEFAULT_WHISPER_CPP_MODEL.description: Optional whisper.cpp model-name override mapped to MICME_MODEL_DIR/ggml-<name>.bin unless MICME_WHISPER_CPP_MODEL is set. Leave unset for the mode default: small.en for clip (small for translation), base.en for English stream, and base for stream with language detection, non-English input, or translation.

MICME_WHISPER_CPP_MODEL.description: Advanced whisper.cpp exact ggml/gguf model path override. When set, it wins over MICME_DEFAULT_WHISPER_CPP_MODEL.

MICME_WHISPER_CPP_BIN.description: Command or path for whisper.cpp clip transcription. Leave unset to find whisper-cli/whisper-cpp on PATH.

MICME_LIVE_BIN.description: Command or path to the Micme Worker v1 executable. Leave unset to find micme-live on PATH. Not whisper-stream.

MICME_VAD_MODEL.description: Optional existing Silero VAD model file for the live worker. Leave unset to use vad/ggml-silero-v5.1.2.bin under the Whisper model cache.

MICME_WHISPER_MODEL.description: Model name passed to the OpenAI Whisper Python CLI when the Python backend is used.

MICME_RECORD_SAMPLE_RATE.description: Raw recording sample-rate override in whole Hz from 8000 through 384000. Clip only. Leave auto/unset so ffmpeg uses the selected input's native sample rate.

MICME_TRANSCRIBE_SAMPLE_RATE.description: Clip processing sample rate in whole Hz from 8000 through 384000. Stream is fixed to 16000 Hz.

MICME_RECORD_SYNC.description: Preserve wall-clock recording duration from ffmpeg timestamps with aresample async correction. Defaults on.

MICME_RECORD_METER.description: Clip only: enable the optional FFmpeg stdout metering branch. Stream meters the PCM sent to the worker.

MICME_AVFOUNDATION_DROP_LATE_FRAMES.description: macOS AVFoundation only. Defaults off so ffmpeg is asked not to drop late frames when capture lags.

MICME_AVFOUNDATION_INPUT_SAMPLE_RATE.description: Advanced macOS fallback from 8000 through 384000 Hz used only when MICME_RECORD_SYNC=0.

MICME_PROCESS_AUDIO.description: Apply configured audio preprocessing. In stream mode the built-in recorder filters capture once; custom recorders own filtering and refinement never filters again.

MICME_VALIDATE_AUDIO.description: Reject near-silent clips and fail when ffmpeg does not provide complete max-volume evidence.

MICME_STREAM_FINALIZE_WITH_CLIP.description: After a successful live stop with recognized words, refine using the selected clip backend on a verified private copy of the same captured samples.

MICME_STREAM_DIAGNOSTICS.description: Report live decoder timings, counts and backlog; does not log transcript text.

MICME_WHISPER_STREAM_BIN.description: Ignored legacy SDL executable. Configure MICME_LIVE_BIN instead.

MICME_STREAM_CAPTURE.description: Ignored legacy SDL device index. Configure the microphone in Audio instead.

MICME_RECORD_COMMAND.description: Advanced shell command hook. Use only trusted commands. In stream mode write a growing 16 kHz mono signed 16-bit PCM WAV to {audio} and finalize its header when stopped.

MICME_TRANSCRIBE_COMMAND.description: Advanced custom transcription shell command. Use only trusted commands; Micme cannot inspect which model it uses.

MICME_ARTIFACT.description: Exact qualified ledger variant ID. Empty keeps the existing model resolver. Do not combine with an explicit conflicting backend or exact model path.

MICME_COMPUTE.description: For the optional adapter: auto, cpu, metal, vulkan, or an exact qualified runtime device ID.

MICME_MODEL_IDLE.description: Unload the optional model immediately, after five idle minutes, or only on request/shutdown. Does not keep the microphone open.

MICME_CHUNKING.description: Enable chunking where supported by the optional adapter. Background jobs always use chunks.

MICME_DETECTOR.description: Speech detector for qualified optional adapter combinations; does not change Worker v1.

MICME_PREFERRED_LANGUAGES.description: JSON-encoded array of BCP-47 language tags, in preference order. Explicit language/translation remains authoritative. Do not include auto.

MICME_WORDS.description: JSON-encoded array of literal vocabulary words or phrases.

MICME_FILLERS.description: JSON-encoded array of literal filler phrases. Used only when filler removal is enabled and supported.

MICME_LOCAL_LID.description: Allow qualified local language identification on eligible batch audio.

MICME_REMOVE_FILLERS.description: Opt into supported local filler removal; preserve the raw final separately.

MICME_SCRIPT.description: Local Chinese script preference where supported. Does not translate.

MICME_HISTORY.description: Opt into saving local takes. Off does not open the library or delete existing rows.

MICME_RETENTION.description: Proposed history policy. N in count:N must be a nonnegative safe integer (0 is valid). Policy changes require confirmation before deleting; starred and imported takes are exempt.

MICME_POLISH_PROVIDER.description: Optional provider for explicitly requested processing of final text. Empty selects no provider.

MICME_POLISH_ENDPOINT.description: Explicit HTTP(S) base URL, without user info, query, or fragment. Do not put credentials in the URL.

MICME_POLISH_MODEL.description: Model ID for the selected final-text provider.

MICME_POLISH_PROMPT.description: Instructions for explicitly requested polishing. Empty uses the conservative fidelity instruction.

MICME_POLISH_KEY_ENV.description: Name of the environment variable containing the selected provider's key. Never put the key itself in this file.

MICME_OUTPUT_HOOK.description: Absolute path to an explicitly trusted Unix executable for final output. Empty disables it. No shell expansion.

^MICME_.description: Micme runtime setting. Values are read as strings by Micme.

legacyStreamSetting.description: Ignored legacy whisper-stream setting. The live worker manages its decoding windows and speech detection.
